text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>Mexico is now the single country the US runs its biggest trade deficit with</u>

Despite Trump's tariffs, Mexico shipped a record 60.55 billion dollars to the US in July — up 33.6% year-on-year — the first time exports to the north ever broke 60 billion in a single month, El Financiero reports. Washington's deficit with Mexico widened 7.2 billion dollars in one month to 27.5 billion, the largest the US holds with any nation on Earth.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Puebla jails its 7th mayor for corruption — this one an opposition MC official</u>

Puebla's attorney general arrested Said Godos Luna, Movimiento Ciudadano mayor of Tepeyahualco, on charges of abuse of authority, bribery and dereliction of duty — the seventh municipal president detained under the state's anti-corruption drive, Regeneración reports. He took office in 2021 amid armed interference in the vote count. The house-cleaning doesn't stop at party lines.

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>Sheinbaum won't manufacture cases: "no investigation, so far" against Adán Augusto or López Beltrán</u>

Pressed by the opposition to prosecute Adán Augusto López and Andrés López Beltrán over "fiscal huachicol," President Sheinbaum said there is "no investigation, so far" against either man — it is the FGR, weighing the ex-navy secretary's complaint for evidentiary value, that decides who is charged, she told reporters, not political demand.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Washington's own files documented torture and disappearances under Calderón and Peña</u>

The same US State Department now branding Mexico a security threat documented, in its 2013 human-rights report, that Calderón- and Peña-era forces carried out "unlawful killings, physical mistreatment, torture and disappearances" — 26,121 people vanished between 2006 and 2012, Contralínea notes, during the very drug war Washington bankrolled through the Mérida Initiative.
banner: US FILES: TORTURE UNDER CALDERON & PENA

text:
🇲🇽🛡️ <u>Mexico deploys 165 anti-drone systems along its entire US border</u>

Defense Secretary Gen. Ricardo Trevilla told a public accountability event that Mexico's security forces now operate "165 anti-drone units along the whole border with the United States" — hardware to detect and bring down the drones crossing from the north. Mexico polices its own airspace, on its own terms.

🇲🇽🏳️‍🌈 <u>Mexico's 2027 budget carves out its first-ever line for LGBTQ+ Mexicans</u>

For the first time in the country's history, the federal budget (PEF 2027) will include "Anexo 33" — a dedicated allocation of 42 billion pesos for the sexual-diversity population, La Jornada reports, funds meant to address health, safety and rights long left off the ledger. A "historic" achievement written into law, not left to goodwill.

🇲🇽💵 <u>SUPER PESO, BEST SINCE 2024</u>

The peso closed at its strongest level since May 2024 — about 16.89 to the dollar — El Economista reports, up more than 6% this year and nearly 10% over twelve months, even as Trump wages tariff war. The drivers: nearshoring investment, World Cup 2026 capital inflows, and June fixed investment up 5.9% year-on-year.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>THE GUNS COME FROM THE NORTH</u>

Washington keeps branding Mexico a "narco-state," but the joint numbers say otherwise: US–Mexico security coordination has cut maritime drug trafficking 95% and delivered record weapons seizures — guns that flow south from the US. Cooperation on Mexico's terms, not submission.

🇲🇽⚡ <u>CFE: DEMAND DOUBLES THE OFFER</u>

Markets just voted on Mexico's public power company: state-owned CFE placed 20 billion pesos in bonds and drew 43.97 billion in demand — 2.2x oversubscribed, rated triple-A by Fitch, Moody's and S&P. Half the proceeds fund solar, hydro and combined-cycle plants. The utility neoliberals spent years trying to dismantle is now investor-grade.

🇲🇽📉 <u>ZACATECAS: HOMICIDES DOWN 96%</u>

Zacatecas — once ground zero of Mexico's cartel war — cut daily homicides 96% since 2021, from 4.5 a day to 0.2, SESNSP chief Marcela Figueroa reported. High-impact crime is down 59% since 2022, and the share of residents who feel unsafe fell from 94.8% in early 2023 to 75.1% today.
